fields.sections.0.h: Occurrence and scale of the security breach incident
fields.sections.1.h: Ongoing incident with limited information disclosure
fields.sections.2.h: Collaborative response with major AI companies
fields.sections.0.ko: OpenCode experienced a security breach last night, identified as caused by a large-scale distillation attack. The attack affected 1.4% of OpenCode Console users. While expressed as a percentage, the absolute number of affected users has not been disclosed, making it difficult to accurately assess the actual scale of the damage.
fields.sections.1.ko: OpenCode cannot disclose additional details because the incident is ongoing. This suggests that the investigation and recovery processes have not been completed, and specific information about the full scope of the attack or the type of information compromised is difficult to obtain at this time.
fields.sections.2.ko: To respond to the incident, OpenCode is collaborating with major AI companies including Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google. This coordination can be interpreted not only as damage recovery but also as recognition of and response to the supply chain risks that a security breach at a developer platform poses to the broader AI ecosystem.
fields.caveat: The source contains only official statements from X (formerly Twitter) and does not include independent verification or detailed analysis from security experts. To confirm the exact nature of the attack technique and the leaked information, additional reporting should be awaited.
